slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round; Cameroon appears only in the annex of composite scores, where its digitisation score falls in the lowest band (under 35%) and its overall score in the 35-49% band. The per-country answers on electronic capture at local offices are not given, so no aspect value can be read and no system is named.
